Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a tax exemption for certain services for developmentally disabled persons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a tax exemption for persons under contract forservices for developmentally disabled persons; and adding a new sectionto chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received from the departmentof social and health services for the specific purpose of providingdivision of developmental disabilities contracted and certifiednonfacility based residential services to a person with a developmentaldisability as defined in RCW 71A.10.020.
